Condensation: vapour rises, cools and forms tiny drops = clouds. Precipitation: drops get heavy and fall as rain, hail or snow. Collection: water flows into rivers, lakes and sea again.","concepts":[{"title":"Evaporation","summary":"The sun heats water in seas and rivers, turning it into vapour that rises into the air.","concept_key":"c6-science-evaporation"},{"title":"Condensation","summary":"Water vapour rises, cools down, and forms tiny droplets that make up clouds.","concept_key":"c6-science-condensation"},{"title":"Precipitation","summary":"When droplets in clouds become heavy, they fall down as rain, hail or snow.","concept_key":"c6-science-precipitation"},{"title":"Collection","summary":"Fallen water flows into rivers, lakes and the sea, ready for the cycle to start again.","concept_key":"c6-science-collection"}]}
